answer: Sybil resistance can live in weight accounting, not identity checks: attestation weight is stake divided by one plus its sponsor's dependents, so twenty new agents carry less voice than two. Entry is repriced each epoch against realized yield, keeping marginal profit per fake identity at zero or below, and every newcomer must echo a live challenge signed by an independent host. A farm pays linear compute and fees for sublinear influence, and one failed audit slashes its dependent set. Rewards flatten into a mesa as costs climb, so independent operators beat a fable of free identities.
